problem: Two non-identical four-quadrant source lanes landed on moving main within the same Trigger-2 interval. Treating both as competing selection-grade authorities would violate the nonduplication/evidence law and could create post-hoc sample/stopping ambiguity.

selection_grade_lane.shape: 512 cases / 256 matched families / 128 cases per quadrant
selection_grade_lane.reason: It matches the existing preregistration's Stage-1 >=64 cases per critical axis and precommits the 64->128->256 expansion structure before candidate outputs are opened. It also balances all four decisions and freezes a strict grader/full-raw-output digest requirement.

compact_lane.reason: 16 cases per critical axis is below the already-preregistered Stage-1 minimum of 64 per critical axis. Its exact two-line response contract, crossed Q3/Q4 evidence-order audit and compact source-binding tests remain useful as donor mechanisms, but its results cannot substitute for or be pooled into the primary selection-grade lane.

fusion_rules: Do not average, pool, concatenate or double-count the two lanes as independent checkpoint evidence.
Do not use compact-lane outputs to tune labels, families, renderer wording, margins, stopping rules or the primary selection-grade manifest.
If the compact lane executes before the primary lane, classify it as smoke/format evidence only and preserve primary-lane cases as unopened for selection purposes.
If overlap with any training/calibration/evaluation family is later discovered, fail closed for the affected selection evidence rather than relabeling it family-disjoint post hoc.
The final Xeno/ClayCode renderer transport gate and exact checkpoint/tokenizer/input/runtime identity remain mandatory regardless of lane.
Current N64 historical results remain exploratory/quarantined and do not become confirmatory through either new source lane.
next_exact_action: Keep P0 runtime quiescence closed. Before any selection-grade B1 output is opened, freeze the practical-margin contract and renderer-interaction decision policy. Treat the compact 32-case lane only as a format/evidence-order smoke donor; do not let it change the primary 512-case frozen families, grader or 64->128->256 stopping structure.
